description: Equipements des canaux à Toulouse is a dataset listed in Data Toulouse Metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Mairie de Toulouse. Equipements et ouvrages jalonnant les canaux à Toulouse (canal du midi, canal de Brienne, canal latéral à la Garonne). Coverage: Toulouse Métropole. The portal files it under Patrimoine. The portal shows 89 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-06-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-toulouse-metropole-fr-portal.
